creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`PaneInput::send` (crates/muster-core/src/input/pane_input.rs) counts every unbound key event as input that owes output, releases included. The daemon writes a release only to a program that asked for releases (crates/muster-daemon/src/writer.rs, the key encoder), so for a shell or a pager it writes nothing and nothing paints. When the program answers the press before the key comes up, the paint settles what the press owed, the release opens a new debt, and `pane:<key>:painting` is raised 10s later about a healthy pane. It clears on the next paint.

Seen on devenv/p2f9c3ayhw, a shell, on 0.19.0: KeyQ press 18:26:19.532Z, bridge.painted 19.556, KeyQ release 19.595, problem.raised 29.600. All 18 painting-stopped warnings in the laptop's run log for 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28 were armed by a release 1-11ms before their 10s clock started. The three runs before that carry 15-22 of the same warning each, not checked for cause.

Not a_2PeXwg4fA (paint reports held until the next frame), which is fixed.

Fix: count presses and repeats only, and send a release uncounted, as `pointer` and `focus` already are. Test: press, paint, release, then the deadline passes with nothing raised.
title: Lifting a key raises a false painting-stopped warning
